kpis.name: sessions_flowing

source.cmd: curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-<PORT>}/stats | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(sum(1 for s in json.load(sys.stdin)['sessions'].values() if s['flowing']))" 2>/dev/null || echo 0

kpis.description: Sessions actually delivering frames — as distinct from sessions that merely connected

kpis.name: stalled_sessions
kpis.description: Sessions connected but no longer delivering. The failure that looks like success.

kpis.name: negotiate_p95_ms
kpis.description: Offer-to-answer time. Climbing usually means ICE is waiting on unreachable STUN.

$comment: Connection state and delivery are tracked separately on purpose.
A session can be 'connected' and carrying nothing; measuring only the
former is how a frozen stream reports perfect health.
